instructions: Samples are shown in random order with anonymous ids; provider, model and voice are hidden until all ratings are submitted.
Listen with headphones at a comfortable volume. Replay is allowed; do not compare file sizes or metadata.
Rate each sample on its own. Read the reference text only after the first listen.
Raters must be fluent in the sample locale; at least three raters per locale.
Do not record your own voice, upload samples elsewhere, or share them outside the review.

criteria.question: How natural does the voice sound?
How easy is it to understand every word?
Are names, numbers and abbreviations pronounced correctly?
Is the speaking rate suitable for a park guide?
Would you publish this for visitors after review?

checks.question: Is any POI or place name mispronounced so that a visitor could not find it?
Does the audio skip, repeat or add words compared with the reference text?

ratingRecord.raterIdPolicy: Pseudonymous id only (e.g. R01). Never store names, e-mails or voice recordings of raters.
